Even Dennis Skinner saying “I solemnly swear that I will bear true and faithful allegiance to the Queen when she pays her income tax” is part of the British political tradition. People haven’t had to make a Christian oath since the mid nineteenth entry. Get over it, Matthew.

Rishi Sunak swore on the Bhagavad Gita. Suella Braverman used the Dhammapada. Forty per cent of MPs in 2024 chose to affirm rather than swear an oath on a religious text. It all counts. It is all part of the British political tradition.
the first MP to take the oath on a Quran was Chaudhry Sarwar in 1997. this isn’t new.
